g.text: The additional effect of link reconfiguration
Matched 10-s experiments | fixed configuration keeps continuous power refinement
The lower panels show every block, including negative differences. Equality tolerance: 1e−9 Mbit/J.
The 10-vehicle batch differs in evaluation window and source snapshot from Figures 1–2 and is shown separately.
A/B are channel realizations, not independent traffic scenes. No matched 50-vehicle no-refinement batch is available.
